name: agent-hud-workspace
description: Shared workspace for the Agent HUD provider and multi-host terminal plugin

scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @agent-hud/provider && npm run test --workspace agent-hud
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run docs:check && npm test
scripts.package:lint: publint run packages/provider --pack npm --strict && publint run plugins/agent-hud --pack npm --strict && attw --pack packages/provider --profile esm-only --no-definitely-typed --format table --no-emoji --no-color
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run package:lint && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
